SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "capacity"::INTEGER >= 200
    AND LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room');
2:
SELECT
    "id",
    "name" AS "event_space_name",
    "event_space" AS "type",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "capacity" = '200'
    AND LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room');

SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" = 'cafe'
    AND LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" != 'cafe'
    OR r."food_service" IS NULL;

                r."address",
                r."food_service"

SELECT
    its."name" AS support_specialist_name,
    s."system_name" AS system_name
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";
110:
SELECT
    its.id AS it_specialist_id,
    its.name AS it_specialist_name,
    s.system_name,
    s.is_active
FROM
    it_support_specialists its
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        s.system_name,
        s.is_active
    FROM
        systems s
    JOIN
        it_support_specialists_systems itss ON s.system_id = itss.system_id
    WHERE
        itss.it_specialist_id = its.id
) s;

112:
WITH internship_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total_internships
    FROM "internships"
),
responsibility_coverage AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS covered_internships
    FROM "responsibilities" r
    JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY r."responsibility"
)
SELECT "responsibility"
FROM responsibility_coverage
WHERE covered_internships = (SELECT total_internships FROM internship_count);

SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
ORDER BY
    j."salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
263:
SELECT
    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" AS "expected_hourly_rate"
FROM
    "salarydetails"
JOIN
    "position" ON "salarydetails"."positionid" = "position"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") LIKE LOWER('%software developer%')
    AND "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" IS NOT NULL;
264:
SELECT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
265:
SELECT j."preferred_years"
FROM "jobs" j
ORDER BY j."salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
266:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years,
    r."skillname" AS required_skills,
    r."proficiencylevel" AS proficiency_level,
    e."degreelevel" AS required_degree,
    e."fieldofstudy" AS field_of_study
FROM
    "jobs" j
LEFT JOIN
    "requiredskills" r ON j."jobid" = r."skillid" 
LEFT JOIN
    "educationrequirements" e ON j."jobid" = e."requirementid" 
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs")
LIMIT 1;
